[[File:Medial deltoidal hexecontahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a medial deltoidal hexecontahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''medial deltoidal hexecontahedron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[rhombidodecadodecahedron]]. Its 60 intersecting [[quadrilateral]] faces are [[Kite (geometry)|kites]].

== Proportions ==
The kites have two angles of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{6})\approx 80.405\,931\,773\,14^{\circ}</math>, one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{8}+\frac{7}{24}\sqrt{5})\approx 58.184\,446\,117\,59^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{8}-\frac{7}{24}\sqrt{5})\approx 141.003\,690\,336\,13^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(-\frac{5}{7})\approx 135.584\,691\,402\,81^{\circ}</math>. The ratio between the lengths of the long and short edges is <math>\frac{27+7\sqrt{5}}{22}\approx 1.938\,748\,901\,931\,75</math>. Part of each kite lies inside the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.
